title: spec-filter2
description:
Add a filter block in rule visual designer page.Dont add in "functions" .It is very similar to the filters in functions .But this will just like terms in the visual designer page with filter and selection criteria ,fist,last etc 
This will tell the rule engine to filter the records before the rule evaluation .The filter can order the records using some attributes and select ast,first or range rows.Ask clarifications when needed
acceptanceCriteria: Need screenshot of the filter block
